# Subromart

> Subromart provides software development, configurable business solutions and ongoing maintenance. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with Bengali and English website content.

## Identity

- Website: https://subromart.com/
- Founder and CEO: Subroto Das
- Founder at Subromart: https://subromart.com/subroto-das/
- Professional portfolio and contact source: https://me.subromart.com/
- Engineering learning resource: https://systems.subromart.com/
- Email: subrotodas1714037@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8801521409155

Subromart (subromart.com) is distinct from other similarly spelled brands. Systems Hub is the founder's personal engineering learning platform; it is not a customer login portal.

## Solutions

- [CampusOS: School Management](https://subromart.com/solutions/school-management/): Bring admissions, attendance, fees, exams and parent communication into a single, easy-to-use school management system.
- [LearnOS: EdTech & LMS](https://subromart.com/solutions/edtech/): Create your own learning platform with courses, video lessons, assessments, payments and a dedicated learner experience.
- [CareOS: Healthcare Management](https://subromart.com/solutions/healthcare/): Connect appointments, patient records, billing and clinic operations with software designed around your care workflow.
- [CommerceOS: E-commerce & Retail](https://subromart.com/solutions/ecommerce/): Sell through a responsive storefront with connected products, inventory, orders, payments and delivery workflows.
- [BusinessOS: Business ERP & Inventory](https://subromart.com/solutions/business-erp/): Connect purchasing, inventory, sales, expenses and reporting in a business system that follows your operations.
- [ConnectOS: CRM & Sales Operations](https://subromart.com/solutions/crm/): Give your sales and support teams one place for leads, conversations, follow-ups, proposals and customer history.
- [TableOS: Restaurant & POS](https://subromart.com/solutions/restaurant/): Manage menus, table orders, kitchen tickets, billing and stock with software built for your restaurant workflow.
- [PeopleOS: HR & Payroll](https://subromart.com/solutions/hr-payroll/): Organise employee records, attendance, leave requests, payroll preparation and staff self-service in one place.

## Services

- [Custom software development](https://subromart.com/services/custom-software/): From the first workflow sketch to a working product, we build software around your people, processes and goals.
- [Website & web applications](https://subromart.com/services/web-development/): Fast, responsive websites and web platforms that make it easier for your customers to understand, trust and work with you.
- [Mobile app development](https://subromart.com/services/mobile-apps/): Purposeful Android and iOS experiences with connected APIs, clear navigation and the features your users actually need.
- [Frontend development](https://subromart.com/services/frontend/): Turn designs into fast, accessible interfaces that work beautifully on mobile, tablet and desktop.
- [Backend & API engineering](https://subromart.com/services/backend-api/): Connect your products with well-structured APIs, clear permissions, reliable data flows and maintainable backend systems.
- [UI/UX & product design](https://subromart.com/services/ui-ux/): Research, user journeys and practical prototypes that help you make clearer product decisions before development begins.
- [Maintenance & managed support](https://subromart.com/services/maintenance/): Keep your software cared for after launch with agreed monitoring, updates, backups, fixes and ongoing improvements.
- [Cloud & deployment](https://subromart.com/services/cloud-devops/): Practical hosting, deployment pipelines and operational visibility for your web applications and backend services.
- [Integrations & automation](https://subromart.com/services/integrations/): Connect payments, messaging, internal tools and external services so your team spends less time moving data by hand.

## Factual boundaries

Solution dashboards use illustrative sample data, not real customer records. Scope, availability, price, licensing, support coverage and delivery dates are agreed in a written proposal. The work section attributes the founder's professional experience and engineering resources; employer projects are not advertised as Subromart client commissions or products for resale. There is no online checkout. Contact forms prepare a message locally, then let the visitor choose to send through WhatsApp or email.

## Languages

English is the default at / and Bengali is available at /bn/. Both language versions are static HTML with canonical and hreflang links. Feature and setup details use native HTML details elements: visitors can expand them, and the full text is present in the original HTML.
